note: Integer weights applied as value × weight / 1000 to the solver metrics (FR-082). Class thresholds are per band because scores grow with level scale. Bands 11–100 were calibrated by trial generation of the draft picture library (Normal levels score about 950–1600, tuned levels reach about 3000); later bands are extrapolated. Recalibrate after playtests. Bands with big levels (spec 001 FR-008 as amended on 2026-10-06: from L525 every milestone level has a board of 289–616 cells) carry their own big thresholds, set 1500 above the band’s from trial generation on sketched big pictures (Normal big levels scored about 2000–3550); recalibrate them once the big pictures exist. Kept unchanged on 2026-10-06 after the first generation on the regular boards of 224–288 cells (the owner): the tuned scores are bimodal on levels that mix mechanics (the rejected Super Hard candidates of L21 stayed at 1380–1776 and the accepted one reached 3327; L1001 reached 3437), so a lower Super Hard minimum would not make them pass more often, while a practice level, one mechanic alone, tops out at about 2550 (L151, 119 candidates: median 2018, 90th percentile 2323, none over 2549, against its band’s 3100), below any minimum that leaves the Hard range intact. Practice levels are therefore never Super Hard: the schedule moves such a Super Hard to the next free level (spec 001 FR-059 as amended). The Daily Challenge's thresholds (2026-10-07, the owner's 22×28 boards in four Normal, two Hard and one Super Hard a week) come from trial generation on the 24 big pictures of 22×28 at the L50 unlocks: Normal levels scored 2135–3576 (12), and the best score the tray tuner reached on 718 Hard and Super Hard candidates was 2760 at the median, 3477 at the 90th percentile, 3702 at the 95th and 4544 at most (the big bands' 4600 is out of reach). So Hard starts at 3150 and Super Hard at 3500: about one candidate in eight reaches Hard and one in eleven Super Hard, with the icons board's peak of 3–4 slots.
